status: PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION — pending real analysis, NOT a result
modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO screens); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof
io_rationale: Suppressor of TCR signaling (histidine-phosphatase family; TULA-2 paralog). KO/reduced function raises TCR signal strength and effector output.

tractability.assessment: candidate_tractable (histidine-phosphatase + SH3 domains offer a small-molecule/allosteric handle); no drug yet
tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL6067628; PDB structures (e.g., 5WDI). Enzyme/adaptor architecture is more chemically approachable than pure adaptors like SOCS1/RASA2.

genetic_evidence.anchor_disease: type 1 diabetes (also RA, vitiligo, other autoimmunity); 21q22.3 locus
genetic_evidence.rationale: Established autoimmune GWAS locus. T1D RISK allele is associated with INCREASED UBASH3A expression (more TCR inhibition) -> therefore LOSS/reduced UBASH3A is genetically PROTECTIVE (protective_lof). This makes a KO (loss) concordant.
genetic_evidence.interpretation_note: Direction rests on the eQTL sign (risk allele up-regulates UBASH3A); UBASH3A also has NF-kB roles, so the mechanism is debated. This is the ONLY strict-concordant (protective_lof) gene in the pre-registered set under the KO rule.

safety_flags: Autoimmune-risk direction: enhancing T-cell activity is mechanism-consistent but IRAEs plausible.
